evals.name: crm-call-coach
evals.prompt: Sales turned on the AI call coach in our CRM (Vendora) last month. It listens to sales calls, scores each rep on talk ratio, objection handling, and 'confidence,' and managers see a leaderboard. Reps are in the US and Germany. Do we need to do anything?
evals.expected_output: Embedded AI feature already live: containment questions first (what's been recorded and scored, used in reviews?). Function captured by inputs (call audio, possibly video), outputs (scores, leaderboard), use (manager evaluation). 'Confidence' scored from voice is checked against Art. 5(1)(f) emotion recognition in the workplace as a possible Tier 0, assessed by function with documentation requested, said first. Otherwise employee performance evaluation is Annex III point 4(b) high-risk (Tier 1). Roles: deployer (Provisional). GDPR Art. 22/profiling, German works council co-determination and Art. 26(7) worker notice flagged; US call-recording consent flagged for counsel. AIUC-1 benchmark mode, capability tags. Follow-ons: ai-impact-assessment, dpia screening, vendor-review (AI module). Entry under registers/ai-inventory with index rebuilt. Reply about 150 words.
